propositions: Eight Jira-specific modules currently at package root must relocate atomically to adapters/jira/ per ADR 0035 decision 4 (no re-export shims permitted).

The loader's lazy_load() call sites for three location-pinned modules (adf.py, outbound_fields.py, comment_limits.py) must be taught relative subpaths (adapters/jira/) without breaking ~30 other root-module loads.

All surviving dotted imports and sibling-path references across jira_fields.py, inbound_fields.py, acli.py, acli_cli_ops.py, and test surface (categories 2&3) must be atomically repointed to new adapters.jira.* locations.
Three categories of test surface must be handled: ~23 path-agnostic patch.object() patches (untouched), ~18 path-constant specs (rewritten), ~18 direct dotted imports (rewritten).
Prerequisite state from story S4 removes core module direct imports, ensuring no core references survive after the move.
Post-move grep verification must confirm zero references to old root paths in src/ and tests/ (excluding path-agnostic _load_acli patches) and all module-size constraints remain satisfied.
